A record-breaking $6 billion cryptocurrency heist has hit Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. Investigators suspect North Korea-linked hackers were behind the massive cyberattack, which has been described as the biggest crypto theft in history.
Binance says hackers allegedly exploited an engineer's laptop to gain access to its systems and execute unauthorised withdrawal transactions. The cryptocurrency exchange has pledged to cover all losses and insists that user funds are safe.
